reviews.weakest: 7: The page calls the road free for everyone while its only runnable path requires GitHub Copilot access with current eligibility and usage limits.
reviews.fix: Replace the entire footer with: `<footer>RAPP is free, open, and MIT licensed. Brainstem runs on your computer but uses GitHub Copilot over the internet, so a GitHub account with Copilot access is required and GitHub's current usage limits apply.</footer>`

reviews.weakest: Line 6 (and 4): Step 5 tells a non-technical user to ask 'any AI' to write an agent and drop it into the agents folder, which silently fails today because outside AIs do not know the BasicAgent/perform/metadata contract and load_agents() ignores any file not named *_agent.py.
reviews.fix:
In Step 5 (line 60), instruct the learner to paste the agent from Step 4 as the pattern and save the result as *_agent.py — replace `
  • Make your own.Ask any AI to write an agent for a chore you repeat. Drop the file into your agents folder. Your Brainstem uses it on your next message.
    • ` with `
  • Make your own.Paste manage_memory_agent.py into your Brainstem (or any AI) and ask it to write a new one like it for a chore you repeat. Save it in agents/ ending in _agent.py, and your Brainstem uses it on your next message.
    • `.

reviews.weakest: 5 (One action): the hero command is clear, but the main flow still carries machinery (open/explorer commands, hidden-folder paths, soul.md, a .py file name, and a Windows command with no Copy button) that belongs behind Details.
